Ruling: maintainer directive on the filing / merging process · items 1 2 3 4 5 6 8 adopted, 7 and 9 not adopted · maintainer 「1 2 3 4 5 6 8」 2026-09-20T13:24Z

Director seat, summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`. In chat the maintainer asked for a business reading of the triage seat's inflow proposal (「降流入 —— 让 dev 席把 out_of_scope_findings 攒批,而不是逐条立卡 … 或者 dev 不立卡,汇总到 pm 来集中立卡」) and whether triage should merge cards or leave it to the PM; this seat presented a ranked list; the maintainer answered with the numbers of the items adopted, verbatim 「1 2 3 4 5 6 8」. This card's original two findings are items 5 and the second half of 4 below; the rest widen it. The skills lane executes: the charter text (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`) is Tier H — the maintainer merges the PR by hand. Thread re-read to its last comment (none) in the act that wrote this.

## Adopted — the rule each item lands, in the words presented

1. **Filing threshold, inverted.** A dev's incidental finding lands in the PR's `## Acceptance notes` by default. A card is filed only for one of three classes: (a) a reproducible defect a user can reach today; (b) a violation of a written contract, with the contract text cited; (c) a metadata trap the runtime refuses or silently drops, with a **named producer**. Observation-class, dormant (no path reaches it today), 「might matter later」 and zero-pull findings are ⛔ not filed — not as a card, not in a digest.
2. **Devs do not file; the lock is mechanical.** The write-identity lock refuses issue creation (`POST /repos/*/issues`) from a dev session; a dev opens its PR and posts its report, nothing else. `out_of_scope_findings` entries in the `os-dev` report contract carry `class: a|b|c` with evidence, or `carrier:` (the PR or person heading for that file); an entry with neither goes to Acceptance notes. The PM seat's ACCEPT comment disposes of every entry in one line each: `filed #N` / `Acceptance notes` / `dropped — <reason>`.
3. **Triage merges at first grading.** Same file + same mechanism ⇒ the later card closes `duplicate_of` the earlier, evidence moved to the earlier; same family, different defect ⇒ ⛔ not merged, linked and ordered into the same batch. In-flight cards (assignee or open PR reference) are never merged. Execution seats do not merge: they raise `pm:retriage` with the reading (which two cards, same file, same mechanism) and triage answers first on its next fire. This is the charter's existing rule (「同文件同缺陷 = 同一发现 … 后卡关 duplicate_of」「open 未认领 ⇒ 先并成一个派发入口」) made a first-touch act, not a label pass.
4. **Two hard lines on the card face.** (i) A card escalated out of an in-flight card's dispatch opens with one line naming which half of the deliverable it carries and which half the parent keeps (the #18159 / #19186 shape this summon had to repair with a pointer). (ii) A card whose own thread carries a `Ruling:` / 「RULED」 comment re-enters `needs-user-decision` only with a `Prior rulings on this card:` line naming each ruling id and one sentence on what changed since; triage's intake check refuses entry without it (`pm:retriage` back to the filer). The five cases are on this card's body.
5. **The director's first batch is presented after the first ≤5 same-family cards are read**; class-1 screening runs per batch, ⛔ not inbox-wide before the first batch; the inbox is ordered from a cheap scan (labels, assignee, PR references, the 速读's first lines), the full read happens on the five in hand. Verifiable: opening marker → first batch ≤ the time to read five cards.
6. **The queue guard's size limb and the `main` ruleset agree** — carried by objectstack#19344 (filed this summon): the guard's remedy text names a path that exists on the ruleset (the Merge button's bypass-rules option), or the ruleset keeps a standing bypass actor; a pin fails when the remedy names a path the ruleset does not offer. Ratified here; #19344 executes.
8. **Same-holder duplicates.** When both cards are held by the same seat (same assignee), that seat closes the later one `duplicate_of` itself — no `pm:retriage` round trip, since no other seat is asked anything. This is the one sentence that widens the 「分诊唯一生产 duplicate_of」 rule, and it widens it only for the case with no cross-seat question.

## Not adopted (recorded so the lane does not re-propose them)

- **7** — a half-state patrol row for a finding with neither a card nor an Acceptance-notes landing. Not adopted.
- **9** — a 「findings not filed this round」 section in the round report. Not adopted.
- **Digest cards** (one card holding N findings) — refused as presented: a second tracker, weaker dedupe, the pile moved rather than shrunk. **Numeric quotas** (at most N cards per round) — refused: arbitrary, and they crowd out real defects; the threshold in item 1 is the instrument.

## Execution

⛔ This seat writes no charter text. The skills lane grades this card (a `finding` in its own lane) and lands items 1–5 and 8 as Tier H PRs against `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (SKILL.md filing rules, `references/lanes/director.md`, `references/state-machine.md` / triage intake, the write-identity lock roster) and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (the report contract in item 2); item 6 lands through #19344. Each PR quotes the maintainer's verbatim 「1 2 3 4 5 6 8」 and this record. Labels on this card untouched by this seat.

They have different fixes and different sizes. If the lane grades them as one card, say which item the grade is for; otherwise split before dispatch rather than at claim time.
